label: TaxParcel
description: A parcel of real property as a taxing authority's assessment roll records it — the lot's identity, who is on the roll for it, how it is classified, and what it was assessed and taxed at for a stated tax year. Epistery-published vocabulary; schema.org types places and real-estate listings, not cadastral parcels or roll records. The parcel identifier is the identity; ownership, classification and value are observations against it for one tax year.

trust.note: Reserved — cadastral proof points (roll year, roll stage, assessing authority, extract date) as the market defines them. A roll record is authoritative only as of its stage and extract date; the vintage belongs here.
